title: 危险化学品的安全储存
source_doc: course/Lab Safety Training - Essential Protocols/02_Safe Storage of Hazardous Materials Best Practices for a Safer Lab.md
author_source: project/Lab Safety Training - Essential Protocols/02_Safe Storage of Hazardous Materials Best Practices for a Safer Lab/src.py

points.K1: 储存不当，就谈不上安全

points.K5: 先弄清容器里装的是什么
points.K6: 爆炸性化学品远离点火源
points.K7: 出口、楼梯、通道不放易燃液体
points.K9: 遇水危险品不与易燃液体同室
points.K10: 安全技术说明书随手可查
points.K11: 规则和培训到位，才能动手
points.K12: 结合本实验室组织培训
points.S2: 管控类化学品：专柜双锁
points.S4: 台账清楚，过期及时清理

shots.section_title: 开场
shots.scene: 欣欣站在一排整齐的试剂柜前
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a row of tidy chemical storage cabinets and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲危险化学品怎么安全储存。
overlay: 危险化学品的安全储存

shots.section_title: 开场
shots.scene: 安全柜、标签、分区、台账四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: a yellow safety cabinet, a blank label with a red diamond pictogram, a shelf divided into zones and a blank logbook. No people.
shots.narration: 进对柜、贴好签、分好区、记好账。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 阿杰把几瓶试剂堆在实验室门口的过道上
shots.prompt_en: The young male student stacks several closed reagent bottles on the floor of a corridor next to the lab door.
shots.narration: 阿杰图方便，把试剂瓶放在门口过道。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 小研看到后皱眉，指着瓶子上模糊的手写标签
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student frowns and points at a smudged blank label on one of the bottles.
shots.narration: 有的瓶子标签模糊，看不出装的是什么。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 欣欣在空白白板前摇头
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot shakes its head in front of a blank whiteboard.
shots.narration: 储存不对，危险一直都在。

shots.section_title: 储存不当，就谈不上安全
shots.scene: 试剂瓶在柜中的时钟图标转了很多圈
shots.prompt_en: Closed reagent bottles on a cabinet shelf with a clock icon spinning many turns above them. No people.
shots.narration: 化学品大部分时间，都在柜子里放着。
overlay: 储存不当，就谈不上安全

shots.section_title: 储存不当，就谈不上安全
shots.scene: 储存和操作两个图标用锁链连在一起
shots.prompt_en: A cabinet icon and a hand-with-flask icon linked by a chain icon. No people.
shots.narration: 储存没做好，操作也谈不上安全。

shots.section_title: 易燃液体进安全柜、贴警示
shots.scene: 黄色易燃品安全柜，门上有易燃警示标志
shots.prompt_en: A yellow flammable storage cabinet with closed doors and a flammable warning sign on the door. No people.
shots.narration: 易燃液体，要放进合格的易燃品安全柜。
overlay: 易燃液体进安全柜、贴警示

shots.section_title: 易燃液体进安全柜、贴警示
shots.scene: 柜门上的禁止烟火标志特写
shots.prompt_en: Close view of a no open flames sign on the door of a yellow storage cabinet. No people.
shots.narration: 柜上贴好警示：易燃，远离火源。

shots.section_title: 容器要合格、要匹配
shots.scene: 小研戴手套检查一个试剂桶的密封盖
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student in safety goggles and gloves checks the tight cap of a plastic reagent container.
shots.narration: 容器本身要合格，还要和物质相匹配。

shots.section_title: 容器要合格、要匹配
shots.scene: 金属瓶和塑料瓶旁各有对应物质图标打勾
shots.prompt_en: A metal can and a plastic bottle side by side, each with a matching pictogram and a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 耐不耐腐蚀、密不密封，都要考虑。

shots.section_title: 易燃液体只用合格容器
shots.scene: 合格的安全罐和破损的饮料瓶，饮料瓶打叉
shots.prompt_en: A proper metal safety can with a green check next to a cracked drink bottle crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 易燃液体，只能用合格的容器盛装。
overlay: 易燃液体只能用合格容器

shots.section_title: 易燃液体只用合格容器
shots.scene: 原包装试剂瓶完好地放在柜中
shots.prompt_en: An original factory-sealed reagent bottle with a blank label sitting safely in a cabinet. No people.
shots.narration: 少量试剂，可以留在完好的原包装里。

shots.section_title: 易燃液体只用合格容器
shots.scene: 很粘稠的液体从瓶口慢慢流动的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a thick syrupy liquid oozing slowly from a bottle mouth, next to an original container icon. No people.
shots.narration: 难倾倒的粘稠物，也可在原包装中使用。

shots.section_title: 易燃液体只用合格容器
shots.scene: 欣欣举着一本空白规章
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a blank rule booklet.
shots.narration: 具体数量界限，按国家和学校规定执行。

shots.section_title: 先弄清容器里装的是什么
shots.scene: 小研拿起一个瓶子，查看完整的标签
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student picks up a reagent bottle and reads its blank label with a red diamond pictogram.
shots.narration: 动手之前，先弄清容器里装的是什么。
overlay: 先弄清容器里装的是什么

shots.section_title: 先弄清容器里装的是什么
shots.scene: 标签上名称、浓度、日期、责任人四栏
shots.prompt_en: A large blank label with four empty fields and a red diamond pictogram corner. No people.
shots.narration: 名称、浓度、日期、责任人，写清楚。

shots.section_title: 先弄清容器里装的是什么
shots.scene: 无标签的瓶子带问号，被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An unlabeled bottle with a big question mark, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 来历不明的瓶子，会带来各种风险。

shots.section_title: 爆炸性化学品远离点火源
shots.scene: 爆炸性物质图标，周围是火焰、热板、火花、太阳四个图标
shots.prompt_en: A GHS exploding bomb pictogram in the center, surrounded by four crossed-out icons: a flame, a hot plate, a spark and the sun. No people.
shots.narration: 爆炸性化学品，远离明火、热源和火花。
overlay: 爆炸性化学品远离点火源

shots.section_title: 爆炸性化学品远离点火源
shots.scene: 阳光透过窗户照到柜子，柜子被移到阴凉处
shots.prompt_en: Sunlight streams through a window onto a shelf; an arrow shows the cabinet moved to a shaded corner. No people.
shots.narration: 也不要被阳光直射。

shots.section_title: 爆炸性化学品远离点火源
shots.scene: 实验室一角划出专用区域，地面有黄线
shots.prompt_en: A corner of the lab marked off with yellow floor lines as a dedicated area with a closed cabinet. No people.
shots.narration: 最好划出专门区域，单独存放使用。

shots.section_title: 出口、楼梯、通道不放易燃液体
shots.scene: 走廊、楼梯、出口三个图标，其中堆放的试剂打叉
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a corridor, a stairway and an emergency exit sign, each with reagent bottles crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 出口、楼梯、人多的通道，不放易燃液体。
overlay: 出口、楼梯、通道不放易燃液体

shots.section_title: 出口、楼梯、通道不放易燃液体
shots.scene: 小研把阿杰放在过道的试剂搬回安全柜
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student and the young male student carry the bottles from the corridor back into the yellow safety cabinet.
shots.narration: 一旦着火，会堵住大家逃生的路。

shots.section_title: 柜外存量有上限
shots.scene: 柜外台面上的试剂瓶被箭头引向安全柜
shots.prompt_en: Reagent bottles on an open bench with arrows guiding them into a closed safety cabinet. No people.
shots.narration: 柜子外面放的易燃液体，数量有上限。

shots.section_title: 柜外存量有上限
shots.scene: 台面只留当天用量的小瓶
shots.prompt_en: A clean bench with only one small closed bottle left beside a calendar icon showing one day. No people.
shots.narration: 超出部分，必须放进合格的安全柜。

shots.section_title: 遇水危险品不与易燃液体同室
shots.scene: 水滴图标与易燃液体瓶之间有一道墙
shots.prompt_en: A water drop icon with a reactive powder jar on one side of a wall and a flammable liquid bottle on the other side. No people.
shots.narration: 遇水会着火的物质，
overlay: 遇水危险品不与易燃液体同室

shots.section_title: 遇水危险品不与易燃液体同室
shots.scene: 两个房间图标，各放一类物质
shots.prompt_en: Two separate room icons, one holding a sealed jar with a water-reactive pictogram and the other holding a flammable liquid bottle. No people.
shots.narration: 不能和易燃液体放在同一个房间。

shots.section_title: 安全技术说明书随手可查
shots.scene: 安全柜旁的文件架上放着空白说明书
shots.prompt_en: A wall rack next to a chemical cabinet holding blank safety data sheet folders with red diamond pictograms. No people.
shots.narration: 安全技术说明书，要放在随手能查的地方。
overlay: 安全技术说明书随手可查

shots.section_title: 安全技术说明书随手可查
shots.scene: 阿杰用平板查到一份说明书
shots.prompt_en: The young male student looks up a blank safety data sheet on a tablet next to the cabinet.
shots.narration: 每种化学品性质不同，危害各有特点。

shots.section_title: 规则和培训到位，才能动手
shots.scene: 王老师拿着规程，阿杰在听讲
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator holds a blank procedure binder while the young male student listens.
shots.narration: 规则没定好、培训没完成，
overlay: 规则和培训到位，才能动手

shots.section_title: 规则和培训到位，才能动手
shots.scene: 未经培训的手伸向试剂柜，被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A hand reaching for a chemical cabinet, crossed out with a red X, next to a blank training certificate. No people.
shots.narration: 就不能使用，也不能储存这种化学品。

shots.section_title: 结合本实验室组织培训
shots.scene: 王老师在本实验室现场带学生认识试剂柜
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator walks students through the chemical cabinets inside their own lab.
shots.narration: 培训要结合本实验室的物质和设施。
overlay: 结合本实验室组织培训

shots.section_title: 结合本实验室组织培训
shots.scene: 通用证书图标打叉，现场培训图标打勾
shots.prompt_en: A generic certificate icon crossed out next to an on-site training icon with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 一张通用证书，代替不了现场培训。

shots.section_title: 分类分区，禁忌物隔离
shots.scene: 欣欣站在分区标识的试剂柜旁
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside chemical cabinets divided into colored zones.
shots.narration: 化学品要分类、分区存放。

shots.section_title: 分类分区，禁忌物隔离
shots.scene: 酸和碱、氧化剂和有机物两对图标分开
shots.prompt_en: Two pairs of icons separated by red barriers: an acid bottle away from a base bottle, and an oxidizer pictogram away from a flammable pictogram. No people.
shots.narration: 酸碱分开，氧化剂远离易燃物。

shots.section_title: 分类分区，禁忌物隔离
shots.scene: 小研对照说明书确认放置位置
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student checks a blank safety data sheet before placing a bottle in a cabinet zone.
shots.narration: 能不能放一起，查说明书的禁忌项。

shots.section_title: 管控类化学品：专柜双锁
shots.scene: 带两把锁的专用铁柜
shots.prompt_en: A sturdy metal cabinet with two separate padlocks on its door. No people.
shots.narration: 剧毒、易制毒、易制爆，要专柜存放。
overlay: 管控类化学品：专柜双锁

shots.section_title: 管控类化学品：专柜双锁
shots.scene: 小研和老周各拿一把钥匙一起开柜
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student and the older man each hold a key and open the double-locked cabinet together.
shots.narration: 双人保管、双把锁，取用双人在场。

shots.section_title: 管控类化学品：专柜双锁
shots.scene: 两人在空白领用登记本上签字
shots.prompt_en: Two hands sign a blank usage register beside the double-locked cabinet. No people.
shots.narration: 领用、归还都要登记，账物相符。

shots.section_title: 储存条件与设施
shots.scene: 通风良好的试剂柜，箭头表示排风
shots.prompt_en: A ventilated chemical cabinet with arrows showing air drawn out through a duct. No people.
shots.narration: 储存处要通风、阴凉、避光。

shots.section_title: 储存条件与设施
shots.scene: 试剂瓶放在托盘里，放在柜子下层
shots.prompt_en: Reagent bottles standing inside a plastic spill tray on a low cabinet shelf. No people.
shots.narration: 瓶子放进托盘，不放高处、不堆地上。

shots.section_title: 储存条件与设施
shots.scene: 防爆冰箱打勾，普通冰箱打叉
shots.prompt_en: An explosion-proof lab refrigerator with a green check next to a household refrigerator crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 易燃试剂冷藏，要用防爆冰箱。

shots.section_title: 台账清楚，过期及时清理
shots.scene: 阿杰在空白台账上登记新到试剂
shots.prompt_en: The young male student records a new reagent bottle in a blank inventory logbook.
shots.narration: 建立台账，进出数量记清楚。
overlay: 台账清楚，过期及时清理

shots.section_title: 台账清楚，过期及时清理
shots.scene: 过期和无标签的瓶子装进废物箱，交给王老师
shots.prompt_en: Old and unlabeled bottles are placed into a collection box and handed to the safety administrator.
shots.narration: 过期、不明试剂，按危险废物交回处置。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现安全柜和标签图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of a yellow safety cabinet and a blank label with a red diamond.
shots.narration: 易燃进柜，容器合格，标签清楚。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 火焰、太阳、通道、水滴四个打叉图标
shots.prompt_en: Four crossed-out icons: a flame, the sun, a corridor and a water drop. No people.
shots.narration: 远离火源阳光，不占通道，遇水物分开。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 分区柜、双锁柜、台账三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a zoned cabinet, a double-locked cabinet and a blank logbook. No people.
shots.narration: 分区隔离，专柜双锁，台账清楚。

shots.section_title: 结尾
shots.scene: 欣欣关好安全柜门，挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot closes the door of a tidy safety cabinet and waves goodbye at the camera.
shots.narration: 放得对、管得严，下次见！
